contentSections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
contentSections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Wave Kinect Propel Mattress? The Wave Kinect Propel is Duroflex's first smart bed-compatible medium soft mattress designed to flex with adjustable beds while maintaining premium comfort on standard beds. It features a 3-Zone Pocketed Spring core, Anti-Stress Fabric, advanced cooling technology, and responsive support engineered for all sleep styles. 2. What problem does Wave Kinect Propel solve? It solves the compatibility gap between traditional mattresses and adjustable smart beds. Unlike standard mattresses, Kinect flexes seamlessly with Zero Gravity, Anti-Snore, and Massage modes without creating gaps or compromising aesthetics. It also delivers stress relief for enhanced sleep quality. 3. Who is Wave Kinect Propel best for? The mattress is ideal for anyone upgrading to a smart adjustable bed or looking for dual-function versatility. It suits all sleep styles, body types, and lifestyles, whether you're seeking smart sleep technology or simply want a responsive, cooling mattress for standard beds. 4. How does Wave Kinect Propel work? The Kinect technology allows the mattress to flex and contour with the adjustable bed's every movement. The 3-Zone Pocketed Spring system provides targeted support, while the Anti-Stress Fabric creates a calming sleep environment. The responsive foam layers adapt to body curves, ensuring zero motion transfer and stable, silent support. 5. How is Wave Kinect Propel different from alternatives? Unlike conventional mattresses, Kinect is engineered specifically for smart beds, flexing without compromising comfort or aesthetics. It offers dual-function performance—excellent on adjustable beds and equally effective on flat, standard beds. Its unique combination of 3-Zone Pocketed Springs, compatibility with Zero Gravity modes, silent operation, and Anti-Stress Fabric sets it apart from traditional mattress options. 6. How does Wave Kinect Propel feel The mattress provides a medium-soft feel with responsive support. It combines pocketed spring construction with foam layers that adapt to body contours, delivering plush comfort balanced with firm spinal support. 7. Does Wave Kinect Propel come with a warranty? Yes, the Wave Kinect Propel comes with a 10-year warranty and a 100-night return guarantee. 8. How to care for Wave Kinect Propel? Use a mattress protector to shield against dust, spillage, and allergens. Do not flip or turn the mattress. Avoid ironing, folding, or smoking in bed as these can damage the mattress structure and fabric. Get professional deep cleaning done bi-annually to maintain freshness and hygiene.
